title: The Eagle Has Landed
author: Jack Higgins
summary: In 1943, German paratroopers are sent to a quiet English village on a daring mission to kidnap Winston Churchill. The book follows the planners, the soldiers and the villagers who stand in their way.
readIf: you like a Second World War thriller with a believable what-if plot and a plot-driven pace.
skipIf: you want an anti-war novel or a book with morally clear sides.

pairings.reason: Another meticulous plot to kill a famous leader, told with great precision.
A tenser, bleaker espionage novel, with more moral weight.
A war novel built around a single mission, with a more literary and personal focus.
